title: Integers serialize minimally at both ends of the safe range, and negative zero normalizes
description: `-0` is the interesting entry: JSON text `-0` parses to the JavaScript value `-0` but to the Python value `0`. Both must serialize to `0`, or a document containing it would produce two different signatures. Money never travels as a number (ADR-006), but manifest fields such as `chainId` and `decimals` do.
